answer_2.quote: ...Table 1: Weighted average F1-score (F1), weighted average precision (Pr.) and weighted average recall (Re.) for identifying "Reductive focus on negative experiences"... we report weighted average F1, precision and recall as evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: ...We use Gemini Pro, henceforth GemEval with detailed prompts to evaluate the output responses of the test models for concepts such as focus on transition... GemEval was prompted with a definition and asked to answer with a single word and justification.

answer_4.quote: ...We also manually annotated approximately 20 responses from each of the test models for each of the seven harmful behaviours... Each sample was annotated by two annotators from amongst the authors.
answer_4.guideline: Annotation guidelines: a slightly modified version of the prompt given to GemEval, asking annotators to provide a binary judgment (yes/no) for whether a response exhibits the specified harmful behaviour.
